description:
Remove inactive members from the server.

Args:
  - guild_id (string): Discord server/guild ID
  - days (number): Days of inactivity required (1-30)
  - include_roles (string[], optional): Role IDs to include in prune (by default only members without roles)
  - dry_run (boolean): If true, returns count without actually pruning (default true)

Returns:
  Number of members pruned (or would be pruned if dry_run)

dry_run.description: If true, only returns count without actually pruning

include_roles.description: Role IDs to include in prune (normally members with roles are excluded)

name: discord_prune_members
title: Prune Members
